description: This is a required library for studies that take input from a MIDI instrument. It provides a setup component that requests Web MIDI access, lists the connected instruments, and asks the participant to play one note to confirm the instrument works before the study relies on it.
additionalDescription:
**Web MIDI is available in Chrome and Edge only.** Safari does not implement it on any platform or version, and Firefox requires participants to install a Site Permission Add-On first. The `midiConnection` component detects an unsupported browser and tells the participant what to do instead of failing silently, but a study that needs a MIDI instrument should say so in its introduction and screening.

Capture itself is separate from this component: set `captureMidi` in `uiConfig`, or on the individual components that should record, to write `midinoteon`, `midinoteoff`, `midicc` and `mididevice` entries into `windowEvents`.

midiConnection.description: Request MIDI access and confirm the participant's instrument works
